title: Sustainable design of new energy vehicle forms based on visual attention sequences and the Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes a method integrating visual attention sequences with the Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer (KAT) for sustainable design of new energy vehicle forms. It uses eye-tracking to capture user focus and employs a large language model to refine emotional vocabulary, then maps these to design parameters using KAT.
